period_note: BASIS BREAK FROM THE MAIN SERIES: Consolidated only, same as 2025_Q1.json/2025_Q2.json (no Separate/Bank-only statement set is printed anywhere in this filing) -- flagged per the project's Solo-preference rule. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2025 (column headed '01 January to 30 September 2025'); the source also prints a discrete quarter-only column ('01 July to 30 September 2025': Net profit after tax -535,263,878, EPS -0.78) -- cross-checked: Q3-cumulative NPAT -1,389,596,931 minus this dataset's own H1 (2025_Q2.json) NPAT of -854,333,053 = -535,263,878, matching the discrete Q3 column exactly, confirming full internal consistency across this dataset's own Q1/Q2/Q3 2025 files. EPS is plain 'Earnings per share (EPS)', not annualized. Consolidated Balance Sheet identity verified exactly (Total Liabilities 96,297,959,037 + Total Shareholders' Equity 7,388,293,983 = Total Assets 103,686,253,020). CONTINUING RISK SIGNAL (see 2025_Q2.json for the H1 onset): Net interest income remains negative cumulatively (-365,900,852) though the Q3-alone discrete figure improved slightly to -75,093,444 from Q2-alone's -797,619,348. Specific provision expense continued at an elevated pace (2,232,847,034 cumulative for the 9 months vs 300,545,926 in the same period of 2024, per the source's own comparative column -- a ~7.4x increase), pushing cumulative Total provision (D) to 2,373,777,166 and the cumulative loss to -1,389,596,931 (from -854,333,053 at H1). Total shareholders' equity fell further to 7,388,293,983 (from 7,908,912,483 at H1, 8,806,646,744 at Q1) and NAVPS to 10.70 (from 11.45, 12.75) -- a sustained, worsening asset-quality event through the first three quarters of 2025, only partially reversing by mid-2026 (see 2026_Q2.json, where the bank's own BSEC-mandated disclosure states the NPL ratio was brought down to 7.49% and the loan-loss provision expense fell substantially from the 2025 peak).
